liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Little Red Rooster**: rare: 9 archived performances [23]
- **Rhythem Devils**: rare: 4 archived performances [23]
- **Johnny B Goode**: rare: 13 archived performances [23]
- Earliest performances in the archive: The Days Between [23]

## The recordings

- **dac2016-06-21** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 193 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener says the recording sounds as good as or better than being at the show [16]
- **GD2016-06-21.AKG**: source not stated; 18 songs; 193 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **DeadCo2016-06-21**: source not stated; 18 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **dnCo2016-06-21.DnCo2016-06-21.OmniHyper24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 194 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Mix balances omnis at -5dB in set one and -6dB in set two against the hypercardioid mono center at 0dB [4]
- **DnCo2016-06-21.OmniHyper16.flac**: source not stated; 18 songs; 194 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Set one mix used omnis at -5dB, set two at -6dB, with the hypercardioid mono at 0dB [5]

## Around the show

- Taped from Section 9, Row MM, seat 15, left side, with mics on a 7.5-foot stand aimed at the stacks [2]
- Recorded from the lawn, about 30 feet up, by Brian Goldstein [3]
- Taped on the lawn about 175 feet back, mics 9 feet high; omni mounts 36 cm apart [4]
- Taped from the lawn about 175 feet back; the uploader enjoyed the beautiful evening with fellow tapers-section people [5]
- Listener stood at the front of the lawn section and found this the best of three Dead & Company shows seen [17]
- Listener watched the concert on the live-stream [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dac2016-06-21**: taped by Bill Goldberg; transferred by Bill Goldberg; source: Audience [1]
- **GD2016-06-21.AKG**: taped by Mark Van Blunk; transferred by Mark Van Blunk; source: 4 mic mix- 2 AKG c414 mics (WideCard) & 2 AKG c451ck8 mics>Tascam DR-70D (as preamp)>Sony M10 @24bit/48kHz [2]. Also: Sony M10 files were tracked and converted to 16-bit/44.1kHz in Sound Forge Studio 9.0, then FLAC level 8; taped and mastered by MVB [2]
- **DeadCo2016-06-21**: taped by Brian Goldstein; transferred by Brian Goldstein; source: AKG 480b CK63 ->Darktrain Silver Cables-> Grace Lunatec V3 -> GAK Interconnects ->Tascam DR-40d 24/48 [3]
- **dnCo2016-06-21.DnCo2016-06-21.OmniHyper24**: taped by Kyle Holbrook; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: AKG ck22s 3ft split + 1 Beyer M201E >Tascam D680 (24/48) >SD [4]. Also: AKG CK22 omnis plus a Beyer M201E hypercardioid into Tascam D680 at 24/48; edited in Audacity, FLAC via TLH [4]
- **DnCo2016-06-21.OmniHyper16.flac**: taped by Kyle Holbrook; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: AKG ck22s 3ft split + 1 Beyer M201E >Tascam D680 (24/48) >SD [5]. Also: AKG CK22 omnis plus Beyer M201E hypercardioid into Tascam D680 24/48, then Audacity and FLAC; this is the 16-bit version [5]
